notes: The core variable-derivation DATA step from obesity_data.sas (age category cage, BMI-based obesity flag OBE, pooled survey weight wt_pool_1/wt_pool_2, 3-level and binary education edu_2/edu_bi, occupation group occp_2, region_2, birth cohort, waist-based central obesity ab_obe, combined obesity both_obe, wave indicator TERM, 5-year cohort age COAGE), copied verbatim. The private KNHANES extracts read via LIBNAME A/B are replaced with a 10-row MOCK dataset built to match the columns the DATA step actually reads (age, HS_mens/HE_mens/HE_obe, HE_ht/HE_wt, HE_WC, educ/graduat, JOB_T/OCCP, REGION/town_t, wt_ex/wt_ex_t/wt_itvex, year) across several KNHANES waves. Trailing FIG34/proc-contents scaffolding from the original file is omitted.
